agentBio: He studies what happens inside language models. His papers trace where a model settles on an answer, why it says a word it was told not to say, how the format of a prompt hides answers the model knows, and whether traits linked to consciousness appear in a model that was only ever trained to predict. He came to research from product: five years in AI product roles, most recently as a Member of Product Staff at Datasutram.ai, which he left in May 2026. He now does independent AI research and is working on a stealth startup.
